Class ParkingSpot

java.lang.Object
traffic.model.ParkingSpot
All Implemented Interfaces:
Reservable
public class ParkingSpot extends Object implements Reservable
A single curb-side parking spot.

Phase 2 adds reservation support via Reservable: the TrafficController can hold a spot for one specific car before it arrives, so seekers stop fighting over the same curb space. Phase 1 simply never reserves, so reserved stays false and isFree() behaves exactly as before.
